name: std::erase_if (std::flat_multiset)

declarations.code:
template <class Key, class Compare, class KeyContainer,

    class Pred>

std::flat_multiset<Key, Compare, KeyContainer>::size_type

erase_if(std::flat_multiset<Key, Compare, KeyContainer> &c,

    Pred pred);

intro:
Erases all elements that satisfy the predicate pred from c.

The predicate pred is satisfied if the expression bool(pred(std::as_const(e))) is true, where e is some element in c.

Key must be MoveAssignable. Otherwise, the behavior is undefined.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
c

 -

 container adaptor from which to erase


 pred

 -

 predicate that returns true if the element should be erased

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text: Exactly c.size() applications of the predicate pred.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: If erase_if throws, c remains in valid but unspecified (maybe empty) state.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: The algorithm is stable, that is, the order of elements that are not deleted remains unchanged.

summary: Erases all elements that satisfy the predicate pred from c.
